description: DDT 91 : Plan de prévention du risque d'inondation (PPRI) de l'Essonne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cnig.gouv.fr. The different zoning of the Essonne River Flood Risk Prevention Plan (PRIP). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DDT 91: Essonne Flood Risk Prevention Plan (PRIP)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inondation. The listing shows 2013-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
